lines.text: The elders call Gilead their witness, and the people make Jephthah their leader and commander.
Edom and Moab refuse Israel passage, and Sihon king of the Amorites gathers his people, encamps at Gilgal, and fights Israel.
Jephthah says Israel has lived in Heshbon for three hundred years, but the king of the Ammonites ignores his message.
